## Overview
The **DRI** (tsRNA Regulatory Index) package provides a generalizable computational framework to score tsRNA network activity from bulk transcriptomes.

## Quick Start
We have provided a built-in toy dataset (`expr_toy`) so you can test the package immediately without external data.

```{r, eval=TRUE}
library(DRI)

# Calculate DRI using the built-in toy data
res <- calculate_DRI(
  expr_mat = expr_toy, 
  tds_genes = c("TG", "TSHR", "PAX8", "SLC5A5", "NKX2-1")
)

# View the calculated DRI scores
print(res$DRI_score)
```

## Adapting to other cancer types
Because the framework is parameter-agnostic, you can easily apply it to other cancers by simply changing the `tds_genes` and `anchor_gene`.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Example: Applying to breast cancer
# res_brca <- calculate_DRI(
#   expr_mat = your_brca_matrix, 
#   tds_genes = c("ESR1", "PGR", "ERBB2"), 
#   anchor_gene = "NSUN2"                  
# )
```
